title: Glasses
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox='0 0 100 100'>
  <!-- Left lens frame -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='6'/>
  <!-- Right lens frame -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='6'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <path d='M52 50 Q50 42 48 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left temple arm -->
  <path d='M8 50 Q2 50 0 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right temple arm -->
  <path d='M92 50 Q98 50 100 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left lens shine -->
  <path d='M20 40 Q24 34 30 34' fill='none' stroke='#a6e3ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right lens shine -->
  <path d='M60 40 Q64 34 70 34' fill='none' stroke='#a6e3ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left lens tint -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='19' fill='#5ec8e5' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- Right lens tint -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='19' fill='#5ec8e5' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
